problems.reason: Both sentences state that the holotype was found in early Coniacian-aged rocks at the El Rosario site, repeating the same information.

Sentence 14 states Muzquizopteryx lived during the early Coniacian stage, while sentence 15 claims it lived between 93.9 and 85.7 Ma, spanning the Turonian to Coniacian stages, which includes an earlier Turonian interval not consistent with early Coniacian only.
